mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread: thrust mains produced since 2024 are said to slide onto the cap and block groove too easily rather than being an interference fit, raising a risk of spinning the thrust bearing. The snippet reports a King technical specialist agreeing the 2024 free-spread spec is out of spec, and that 2025 mains were found the same.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports receiving in-spec NOS Clevite thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread. Poster reports King STDX main thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, on more than one BMW S85/S65 block, plus a packaging error mixing oversize shells into a standard box.
